source_basis: kboot.c2518-2521 explicitly names disp_reserved_regions_vram as boot framebuffer/vram; no inference from a generic covering interval.
kboot.c2523-2548 dt_vram_reserved_region resolves /vram then adt_get_reg(reg,0) into region.paddr/region.size and supplies that named framebuffer reserved region.

Pinned ADT get_reg interprets parent address/size cells and translates parent ranges. Saved /vram is directly below a root with2address/2size cells and no ranges, yielding one16-byte LE physical-base/size descriptor.

BootArgs original736R2/V2 video fields at40..80 and byte stride*height establish only the visible pitched footprint. Explicit /vram/reg is a larger, separately named firmware-declared reservation extent.
producer_implication: A future source-bound producer can use the entire explicit /vram/reg0 firmware-declared framebuffer/VRAM reservation extent as a candidate tag3 source fact, with exact raw property/ADT digest and sameboot identity. This avoids inventing an allocation from MCC coverage or geometry.

Require exact supported path/device_type/cells/cardinality and trusted translation, nonzero/overflow-free PA36/16KiB extent, whole visible-footprint containment, and original/final video-field consistency before emitting a fact.

Do not call the descriptor an independently proved physical allocation/ownership or global VRAM census. It is exact named source metadata; source provenance and current-boot consistency remain required.
Zero MemoryMapReserved entries supply no alternative footprint containment proof. MCC old80 list remains wholly disjoint and cannot backfill full384 capture.
